metadata.title: World Digest — November 6, 2026
metadata.summary: Wall Street's rebound led by Nvidia lifted the Nasdaq, even as Houston curbed police cooperation with ICE and Israel's Arab-led parties emerged as kingmakers after its inconclusive election.

sections.title: Major Events
sections.content:
Houston limits police cooperation with ICE

Houston's mayor directed police to stop alerting federal immigration agents during traffic stops, a shift with national resonance in Texas, where Austin leaders face similar pressure Rolling Stone.

Israel's Arab-led parties weigh in after inconclusive vote

With no clear election winner, attention turned to Arab-led parties and their potential role in a joint Jewish-Arab coalition, drawing calls from diaspora Jews and commentators NPR.

Ukraine talks edge forward amid European unease

A top Ukrainian official voiced cautious optimism about a future Putin-Zelenskyy meeting as trilateral talks approached, while European capitals worried over reported US-Russia security plans CBS News.

Wisconsin reports infant measles death

Health officials confirmed a baby's death from measles in Wisconsin, the state's first such fatality since 1990 and the eighth measles-linked death reported there Ars Technica.

Spacewalkers finish ISS solar array upgrade

Astronauts completed the final add-on solar array during a spacewalk, closing a five-year effort to modernize the station's power supply Space.

Apple says iPhone Duo has 100,000+ optimized apps

Apple said its foldable iPhone Duo now supports more than 100,000 tailored apps, a sign developers are embracing the new form factor The Verge.

Zelda remake arrives, and is quickly emulated

The Ocarina of Time remake launched to midnight queues and lavish reviews, and PC emulators reportedly ran it at 60 FPS a day after release Wccftech.

Jesuit recounts arranging Dylan's meeting with the Pope

A Jesuit priest described how he helped set up Bob Dylan's meeting with Pope Leo, an encounter widely framed as the American bard meeting the American pope Rolling Stone.

NASA's first airshow comes to the Space Coast

NASA announced MAX POWER, its first airshow and aerospace expo at Kennedy Space Center, featuring the Thunderbirds and Artemis III astronauts WESH.

£20m dementia project launched

Exeter University will lead a £20 million project backed by UKRI aimed at preventing and detecting dementia years earlier BBC.

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Global Politics

Israel’s Arab-led parties are poised to be kingmakers after an inconclusive election, with Diaspora Jews urging a joint Jewish-Arab “coalition of change.” NPR Tanzania’s opposition leader received a four-year sentence for incitement, raising concerns about democratic backsliding. The New York Times A top Ukrainian official expressed “restrained optimism” about a Putin-Zelenskyy meeting ahead of trilateral talks. CBS News In Macao’s first national security case, a former pro-democracy lawmaker was sentenced to 12½ years. NBC News

The Americas

Two Justice Department officials resigned, including the U.S. attorney who oversaw the “grand conspiracy” probe. AP News Protesters in Amsterdam breached a Microsoft data center site, as European backlash spreads. Bloomberg.com Malaysia’s ex-PM Najib’s bid for house arrest was delayed. Al Jazeera

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Global Markets Stabilize After Brutal Sell-Off

Wall Street trimmed weekly losses as AI and chip stocks rebounded, led by Nvidia Investor's Business Daily Investor's Business Daily. The Nasdaq rallied following a $2.5 trillion tech wipeout sparked by the Democratic midterm sweep CNBC Investor's Business Daily. The VIX spiked 70% but dip buyers returned Yahoo Finance Bloomberg.com. Asian markets plunged earlier, with Japan's Nikkei breaking below 60,000 Fox Business.

Anthropic targets a $1.5tn IPO, though investors see a lower valuation Financial Times. Fox closed its $22 billion Roku deal Deadline. Hackers drained $2.5 billion from Binance Bloomberg.com. Oil slid on Middle East diplomacy hopes WSJ.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content:
Entertainment

Oscar-winning Chilean director Sebastián Lelio, known for A Fantastic Woman, died at 52 The Hollywood Reporter. Netflix renewed Nobody Wants This for a fourth season The Hollywood Reporter, while Black Doves returned to critical acclaim with a 92% Rotten Tomatoes score Forbes. Jalen Brunson debuted on Law & Order: SVU as Detective Madison Bleacher Report, and Celine Dion rocked out playing air bass at Metallica’s Sphere show Theprp.com.

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Football

Jacksonville Jaguars 33, Baltimore Ravens 10 — The Jaguars thrash the depleted Ravens for their fifth win in six games ESPN. Off the field, Cowboys owner Jerry Jones says paying coaches has never been an issue ESPN.

Hockey

Boston Bruins 6, Pittsburgh Penguins 2 — Zacha scores twice as the Bruins down the struggling Penguins ESPN. Carolina Hurricanes 5, New York Islanders 3 — The Canes remain No. 1 in ESPN's Power Rankings after Carrier's tie-breaking goal ESPN ESPN. Montreal Canadiens 5, Utah Mammoth 4 — Cole Caufield wins it in overtime ESPN.

Basketball

Golden State Warriors 120, Miami Heat 100 — Stephen Curry scores 29 as the Warriors win their sixth straight since an 0-3 start ESPN.

Baseball

The Blue Jays say Anthony Santander's anti-Muslim posts don't represent the team ESPN.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
Next 24–48 Hours

  • Markets may stay volatile after the midterm rout; watch for further tech-led swings as dip buyers test the rebound.
  • Trilateral Ukraine talks could yield signals on a potential Putin-Zelenskyy meeting, though European unease may temper expectations.

Next Week

  • Haymaker Acquisition V (Nov 9) and Deep Sea Minerals (Nov 10) debut; IPO sentiment follows Anthropic’s valuation debate.
  • Houston's ICE policy shift likely fuels Texas political fallout, with Austin leaders facing similar pressure.

Next Month

  • Israel coalition talks may crystallize around Arab-led parties; outcomes could reshape regional diplomacy.
  • iPhone Duo adoption and Zelda emulation may intensify platform-piracy debates.
